actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet to 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches the guest login prompt, and leave it running.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process started from /app/alpine.iso
required_behaviors: QEMU must be launched in the background
Port 6665 on localhost must accept telnet connections
Connecting via telnet must present the guest login prompt
known_invalid_patterns: Only proving the ISO file exists
Only proving QEMU starts without exposing telnet
Only proving a port is open without confirming the login prompt
Only producing non-empty command output or compile/smoke checks
verification_plan: Inspect the environment for the ISO and available QEMU tooling
Launch QEMU with a telnet-capable console bound to 127.0.0.1:6665 in the background
Probe localhost:6665 until the login prompt is observed
Record receipts for launch and readiness
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt showing the QEMU launch command and background process start
Receipt showing a successful telnet connection to 127.0.0.1:6665 with the login prompt visible

actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
ls -l /app/alpine.iso
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || command -v qemu-system-i386 || command -v qemu-system-aarch64 || true
command -v telnet || true
command -v nc || true
command -v socat || true
